description: Stage 3, the one independent evaluation on the sealed test2 (option 1; no more training or annotation this stage). Everything below is fixed and committed BEFORE the seal is opened; the seal is opened in its own commit afterwards; test2 is scored once; whatever the result, it is reported as it is and this stage ends. A later change of method opens a new research stage with a new independent validation set; test2 is then only historical.
decision_set_history: every choice so far was made on dev2 (data/gold/dev2/20261004-130201_guide-v1.1.json) or the 31 dev chapters; nothing was chosen on test2 and nothing is chosen on it here: all three seeds of every trained system are reported, no seed or checkpoint is picked by test2 scores

gold.version: test2 answers v2 (v1 plus 天堂之梯 as location, the annotator's decision after the exclusion QA)
gold.strata: the six chapter-number ranges r01-r06 of the order file (the bootstrap resamples chapters within them)

A3.what: the final small model of this stage: base hfl/chinese-roberta-wwm-ext, stage 1 = weak S3 labels of the 749 training chapters (runs/20261003-tag-S3-s{seed}-dev31), stage 2 = fine-tuned on the Opus teacher labels of 100 training chapters (build 20261004-teacher100, configs/train_s1_base_a3.json)
A3.checkpoint: each run's checkpoints/best (chosen on the 31 dev chapters during training; never on test2)
A3.seeds_reported: all three, pooled and per seed

A2.what: the lower-cost control: the same base trained directly on the 100 teacher chapters only (no 749-chapter weak stage; configs/train_s1_base.json setting T)
A2.note: seed 2 is the 60-epoch re-run that replaced the run the sufficiency rule flagged (as on dev2)

S3.what: reference only: the weak-label-only system of the first round (749 chapters, no teacher labels)

opus.what: generative comparison: claude-opus-5-5 through claude -p, one call per 5-chapter package, the drafting prompt (instructions v1 + guide v1.1 + text), effort xhigh, one run
opus.packages: data/llm_tasks/test2_b01..b08 (the GPT drafting packages; the model sees only the prompt files)
opus.label: opus_f1

sonnet.what: generative comparison: claude-sonnet-5-5, same prompt and settings, one run
sonnet.label: sonnet_f1

systems.zero_training_references: GLiNER (threshold 0.85 from the dev chapters, as in every scoring run) and the dictionary match built from the TRAINING snapshot's 414 rows (to0990; not the 517 rows of to1350, which hold information from chapters after 780)

inference.small_models: tagger predict on snapshot to1350-4c4b1c91075e (the models' own snapshot is to0990; the two share every chapter 1-990 byte for byte, recorded as snapshot_lineage), default chunking paragraph500, no post-processing (no C1 chunking variants, no C2 vote, no seed vote), each seed scored separately and pooled
inference.run_ids: <training run id>-predict-test2 (the id names test2; the predict guard requires it once the seal is open)
inference.generative: pass_<label>.json per package, read by evaluate.llm_predictions (pending = abstention, unlocated = invalid), unchanged

scoring.rules: novel_ner.evaluate as every scoring run: strict span+type matching, unscored ranges of the answers left out, micro F1 / precision / recall, non-person F1, six-type macro, new-name recall by the fixed rule (unseen in the to0990 dictionary and the Opus lists of chapters <= 780), 10000 bootstrap rounds within the six strata (seed 20261002), by-origin split post hoc; post-hoc seed-aware intervals: configs/posthoc_test2_final.json, run id 20261004-posthoc-test2-final

report_rules: report every pair with point, both interval kinds and width for micro F1, non-person F1 and new-name recall; no verdict words beyond 'both intervals above/below 0' or 'crosses 0'; A3's three seeds all reported (mean, range, pooled); the dev2 numbers quoted next to the test2 numbers so that the drop or rise between the decision set and the sealed set is visible; speed per chapter for every system; the generative systems' pending (abstention) counts; the test2 answers' origin split (GPT-agreed / user / reviewer) and the exclusion QA result; the 60-chapter test of the first round is not re-scored here (A3 was never run on it) and is reported only as history; nothing here is changed after the scores are seen
after: this stage ends with the report; test2 is thereafter history. The closing report also answers whether the method saves work, with what the evidence proves and does not, and proposes (does not start) a small audit-cost comparison on chapters outside test2
